HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 1
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Myself [? (1 mark)
   A. Use Myself [ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Myself [ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself [.
   D. Say Myself [ has no place in daily life.

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Qualities Of Enlightened Beings.

3. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Spreading rumours
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

4. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)

5. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

6. Which response best shows understanding of Basic Prayers? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Basic Prayers with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette:? (1 mark)

   B. Say General Etiquette: has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette:.
   D. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji? (1 mark)
   A. Say Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji.
   C. Use Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Ramayan and Sri Guru Granth Sahib ji with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Religious? (1 mark)
   A. Say Religious has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious.
   C. Apply the teaching of Religious with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Religious to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Mocking other people’s beliefs
